video_title: Lebron is NOT A Top Player He is SCARED of the Moment and Was Stopped by JJ Barea

quotes.speaker: Kwame Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kwame Brown on why LeBron James is not an all-time top-three player
quotes.excerpt: I don't see LeBron in that category. His longevity got him the numbers, but in big moments
quotes.quote: I say that because they put him in that category. I don't see LeBron in that category. His longevity got him the numbers, but in big moments I see him as regular. LeBron can shy away from the moment at times, and I've never seen Kobe or MJ shy away from that moment. That's what they're built for.

quotes.speaker: Kwame Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kwame Brown on LeBron James and Dwyane Wade needing to take responsibility
quotes.excerpt: If you're paid as the number one guy, and you are shooting the bulk of the shots
quotes.quote: If you're paid as the number one guy, and you are shooting the bulk of the shots, you don't get to shy away in that moment. You have to find your way to will yourself to a win. Kobe would always say that, you have to will that win. There's times that LeBron will drive right into trouble so that he can have to pass the ball when he's 6'9". Take that one dribble and pull up, who's going to be there?

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade admits the Heat were outplayed and outcoached in 2011
quotes.excerpt: We got outplayed and we got outcoached. When it came down to winning, we didn't close out games.

text_blocks.speaker: Dwyane Wade
text_blocks.text: The honest truth, we got outplayed and we got outcoached. When it came down to winning, we didn't close out games. We didn't close out games, but that's players and that's coaches. We got outcoached by Rick Carlisle and his staff, and we got outplayed by Dirk Nowitzki and Jason Terry and Jason Kidd, but that little JJ Barea. Nobody give him credit. JJ Barea was the one who changed the series. We didn't have no answer for him.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade reflects on his failure to lead LeBron James in 2011
quotes.excerpt: Me as a leader, Spo as the head coach, we got to do a better job

text_blocks.speaker: Dwyane Wade
text_blocks.text: Me as a leader, Spo as the head coach, we got to do a better job to make sure that he's not struggling. How we getting him the ball in certain places to make it easier for him? Because you know as a player, all you need is one thing to go your way and it turn everything around. We didn't do enough of that for a guy who was struggling.
